claims.statement: Tom Allen is described as the retired heavy-weight champion of this city.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the retired heavy-weight cham- pion, of thiscity.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was present in Charles Mitchell's room at the Southern Hotel on March 5, 1892, when Mitchell dictated his reply to John L. Sullivan's challenge.
claims.excerpt: there was present at the time, Frank P. Slavin, the Australian heavy-weignt; Charies Tate, the retired pugilist cf Toledo, O.,and Tom Allen

notes: Allen only witnessed Mitchell's letter; he said nothing in the article. The reply was dictated the evening before the paper date ('last evening').
